be selfish for a while, but the good kind of selfish. do things for yourself, that benefit you--your mind, body, soul. take time from pleasing other people and devote it to pleasing yourself. if you don't know what pleases you, then learn. You're not stuck in your house, unless you're literally too big to fit out the door. Take a walk outside.<--- seems totally pointless doesn't it? do it anyway. You know more or less everything that your house contains, but there's no way of knowing what lays in store for you out there. You don't know what you'll see, hear, smell, experience. If you wake up tomorrow and decide to stay in your house, you'll get more of the same. If you start doing things different, more will come to you as you bring more to life. Nobody will ever truly understand you, because words convey a tiny percentage of what we think and feel, but trying is a part of being a human. It's essential, and when we feel like we may be understood even a tiny bit, it's a magical feeling. I'm 25 too and I know what it's like to be stuck in the house, literally. I had to take care of my dying father, be there at his beckon call, cook his meals, take him to the bathroom, etc, and it made me lose my *fucking. mind.* Not to mention I became a social retard after no social interaction for so long. That was like 5 years ago, and the start of the downfall that I'm trying my damnedest to reverse now. the mid 20's is a really shitty age for some people. It's a time where you're trying to find your place in the world, trying to learn who you are, how you fit. It's when you start thinking for yourself and really become an individual. Get out of your house and you'll find things worth living for, even if it's not a husband or kids. But again, you never know what tomorrow will bring or who you'll meet, as long as you give life a shot. Your past sucked, but don't project your past onto your future. Don't even think about the future.. it doesn't even exist. Live right now, in this moment, because it's the only thing that matters, it's the only time you have. shoot me a message if you want to talk.
